pages.lesson:
LESSON: BIBLE STORIES: PETER AND JOHN IN THE TEMPLE

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible
Topic 2.2: Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How did Peter and John demonstrate faith in God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. discuss why Christians should stand firm in their faith

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: BIBLE STORIES: PETER AND JOHN IN THE TEMPLE
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: BIBLE STORIES: PETER AND JOHN IN THE TEMPLE
Study Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Discuss why Christians should stand firm in their faith

What this means
In this part you learn to discuss why Christians should stand firm in their faith. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: discuss why Christians should stand firm in their faith.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can discuss why Christians should stand firm in their faith. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: discuss why Christians should stand firm in their faith)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: discuss why Christians should stand firm in their faith.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How did Peter and John demonstrate faith in God?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: discuss why Christians should stand firm in their faith.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
